name: understory
description: Engineering blogs, explained. A reading layer with context, diagrams, and sources.

scripts.db:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply understory --local --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply understory --remote --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config wrangler.jsonc --outdir .tmp/build/web && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config wrangler.pipeline.jsonc --outdir .tmp/build/pipeline
